title: Person harmed when the gauntlet object was retrieved
summary: Randy Anderson tells of Person harmed when the gauntlet object was retrieved, about 2014 at Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, Indiana

plain: Randy Anderson says he saw alien technology at a military base: Naval Surface Warfare Center Crane, a Navy research base in Indiana. He tells of an item he calls the gauntlet object. He says that around 2014 someone mentioned a person may have been harmed while the object was being recovered, which would mean these recoveries carry real danger for the people doing them.
